## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing reason for it.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] Relevant browser component rebuilt
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, resumes, recordings, transcripts, or personal data added
- [ ] No new biometric, accent, emotion, or protected-trait scoring
- [ ] Supabase changes include a new migration and preserve Row Level Security

## Screenshots

Add before-and-after screenshots for visible interface changes.
